chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line03.interpretiveCaution: Intimate knowledge of the heart is devotional language, not a warrant for us to judge another person’s unseen thoughts. The ant-to-elephant comparison includes all beings.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line04.simpleEn: The Divine looks on everyone with a gaze of compassionate grace.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line04.simplePa: ਉਹ ਸਭ ਉੱਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀ ਨਿਗਾਹ ਰੱਖਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras11.line04.interpretiveCaution: Intimate knowledge of the heart is devotional language, not a warrant for us to judge another person’s unseen thoughts. The ant-to-elephant comparison includes all beings.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line01.simpleEn: The suffering of saintly people is felt with concern by the Compassionate One.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line01.simplePa: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਕਰੁਣਾ ਨਾਲ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਗਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line01.interpretiveCaution: Poetry speaks of divine compassion through human terms for suffering and happiness; do not conclude that all forms of suffering are divinely approved or clinically avoidable.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line02.simpleEn: Their happiness and peace are likewise honoured with joy.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line02.simplePa: ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਸੁੱਖ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਹ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਣ ਵਾਲਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line02.interpretiveCaution: Poetry speaks of divine compassion through human terms for suffering and happiness; do not conclude that all forms of suffering are divinely approved or clinically avoidable.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line03.simpleEn: The One recognizes each individual’s particular pain.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line03.simplePa: ਹਰੇਕ ਜੀਵ ਦੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਪੀੜ ਉਹ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line03.interpretiveCaution: Poetry speaks of divine compassion through human terms for suffering and happiness; do not conclude that all forms of suffering are divinely approved or clinically avoidable.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line04.simpleEn: Every inner covering and secret of each heart is known to the Divine.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line04.simplePa: ਹਰ ਘਟ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ ਪਰਦਾ ਅਤੇ ਭੇਦ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਤੋਂ ਓਹਲੇ ਨਹੀਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras12.line04.interpretiveCaution: Poetry speaks of divine compassion through human terms for suffering and happiness; do not conclude that all forms of suffering are divinely approved or clinically avoidable.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line01.simpleEn: When the Creator brings forth or expands creation, the poetic scene opens outward.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line01.simplePa: ਜਦੋਂ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਦਾ ਵਿਸਤਾਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਇਹ ਦ੍ਰਿਸ਼ ਫੈਲਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Udarkh/akarkh” are old literary formulations of expansion and withdrawal, NOT modern cosmological equations. Their precise Braj morphology needs specialist review.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line02.simpleEn: Countless beings then come into embodied existence.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line02.simplePa: ਤਦ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੀਵ ਦੇਹਾਂ ਧਾਰ ਕੇ ਜਨਮ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line02.interpretiveCaution: “Udarkh/akarkh” are old literary formulations of expansion and withdrawal, NOT modern cosmological equations. Their precise Braj morphology needs specialist review.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line03.simpleEn: When the Creator draws that expansive creation inward again, its forms withdraw.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line03.simplePa: ਜਦੋਂ ਉਹ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਨੂੰ ਮੁੜ ਆਪਣੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਮੇਟਦਾ ਹੈ, ਰੂਪ ਸਿਮਟ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Udarkh/akarkh” are old literary formulations of expansion and withdrawal, NOT modern cosmological equations. Their precise Braj morphology needs specialist review.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line04.simpleEn: All embodied beings are portrayed as returning into that One.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line04.simplePa: ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਦੇਹਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੀਵ ਉਸੇ ਇੱਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਲੀਨ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਦੱਸੇ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras13.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Udarkh/akarkh” are old literary formulations of expansion and withdrawal, NOT modern cosmological equations. Their precise Braj morphology needs specialist review.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line01.simpleEn: The whole creation has many voices, mouths and forms of expression.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line01.simplePa: ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਨੇਕ ਮੂੰਹ ਅਤੇ ਬੋਲਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਜੀਵ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line01.interpretiveCaution: Human descriptions are necessarily partial; references to the Vedas or the world must not be treated as proof that each speaker’s separate theology is identical.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line02.simpleEn: Each describes the Divine according to their own understanding.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line02.simplePa: ਹਰੇਕ ਆਪਣੀ ਸਮਝ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਾਰੇ ਬੋਲਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line02.interpretiveCaution: Human descriptions are necessarily partial; references to the Vedas or the world must not be treated as proof that each speaker’s separate theology is identical.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line03.simpleEn: Yet You remain distinct from, and beyond, every one of those descriptions.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line03.simplePa: ਪਰ ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਸਾਰੀਆਂ ਹੱਦਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਨਿਰਾਲਾ ਹੈਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line03.interpretiveCaution: Human descriptions are necessarily partial; references to the Vedas or the world must not be treated as proof that each speaker’s separate theology is identical.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line04.simpleEn: The Vedas and the learned world try to understand this profound mystery.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line04.simplePa: ਵੇਦਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਜਗਤ ਦੇ ਗਿਆਨੀਆਂ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਇਸ ਗੂੜ੍ਹੇ ਭੇਦ ਦੀ ਭਾਲ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras14.line04.interpretiveCaution: Human descriptions are necessarily partial; references to the Vedas or the world must not be treated as proof that each speaker’s separate theology is identical.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line01.simpleEn: The One is without confining form, corruption or dependence on another support.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line01.simplePa: ਉਹ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ, ਵਿਕਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਰਹਿਤ ਤੇ ਕਿਸੇ ਹੋਰ ਆਸਰੇ ਦਾ ਮੁਹਤਾਜ ਨਹੀਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line01.interpretiveCaution: Several Sanskritic/Braj adjectives are densely packed; these are broad working senses only. “Beyond distinctions” should not be used to erase human moral accountability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line02.simpleEn: Beyond ordinary beginnings, colour or birth, the One is self-existent.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line02.simplePa: ਉਹ ਆਦਿ ਤੋਂ ਪਰੇ, ਰੰਗ ਅਤੇ ਜਨਮ ਦੀ ਹੱਦ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚਾ ਤੇ ਆਪ ਹੋਂਦ ਵਾਲਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line02.interpretiveCaution: Several Sanskritic/Braj adjectives are densely packed; these are broad working senses only. “Beyond distinctions” should not be used to erase human moral accountability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line03.simpleEn: A person without understanding tries to divide this limitless One into narrow categories.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line03.simplePa: ਅਣਜਾਣ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਉਸ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਹਸਤੀ ਦੇ ਸੀਮਤ ਭੇਦ ਬਣਾਉਣ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line03.interpretiveCaution: Several Sanskritic/Braj adjectives are densely packed; these are broad working senses only. “Beyond distinctions” should not be used to erase human moral accountability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line04.simpleEn: Even sacred texts cannot completely grasp the One’s deepest mystery.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line04.simplePa: ਵੇਦਾਂ ਵਰਗੇ ਧਰਮ-ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਵੀ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਸਾਰਾ ਭੇਦ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਦੇ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras15.line04.interpretiveCaution: Several Sanskritic/Braj adjectives are densely packed; these are broad working senses only. “Beyond distinctions” should not be used to erase human moral accountability.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line01.simpleEn: Some imagine the limitless Divine to be fully represented by a stone form.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line01.simplePa: ਕੋਈ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਪੱਥਰ ਦੇ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਮਝ ਬੈਠਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line01.interpretiveCaution: The original uses sharp polemical words about treating the formless One as an object or a named deity. Explain the Sikh theological distinction without mocking people or sacred objects of other traditions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line02.simpleEn: The poet sharply calls that a misunderstanding of the deeper reality.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line02.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਇਸ ਨੂੰ ਡੂੰਘੀ ਸੱਚਾਈ ਦਾ ਭੇਦ ਨਾ ਜਾਣਣਾ ਆਖਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line02.interpretiveCaution: The original uses sharp polemical words about treating the formless One as an object or a named deity. Explain the Sikh theological distinction without mocking people or sacred objects of other traditions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line03.simpleEn: Some address Mahadev as though that name alone exhausted the Eternal Divine.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line03.simplePa: ਕੋਈ ਮਹਾਦੇਵ ਦੇ ਨਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਹੀ ਸਦਾ-ਸ਼ਿਵ ਦੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਹੱਦ ਮੰਨ ਲੈਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line03.interpretiveCaution: The original uses sharp polemical words about treating the formless One as an object or a named deity. Explain the Sikh theological distinction without mocking people or sacred objects of other traditions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line04.simpleEn: Such outward naming, the poet argues, can miss the formless mystery.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line04.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਇਹ ਨਾਂ ਫੜਨ ਨਾਲ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰ ਦਾ ਅਸਲ ਭੇਦ ਅਣਪਛਾਤਾ ਰਹਿ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras16.line04.interpretiveCaution: The original uses sharp polemical words about treating the formless One as an object or a named deity. Explain the Sikh theological distinction without mocking people or sacred objects of other traditions.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line01.simpleEn: Each person has only as much understanding as their own mind can hold.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line01.simplePa: ਹਰ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦੀ ਬੁੱਧੀ ਦੀ ਆਪਣੀ ਇੱਕ ਹੱਦ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line01.interpretiveCaution: The first two lines acknowledge diverse human understandings; the final questions express wonder, not a literal refusal of all inquiry or scientific cosmology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line02.simpleEn: So people describe You in differing ways according to that understanding.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line02.simplePa: ਇਸ ਲਈ ਲੋਕ ਆਪਣੀ-ਆਪਣੀ ਸਮਝ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵੱਖਰੇ ਢੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line02.interpretiveCaution: The first two lines acknowledge diverse human understandings; the final questions express wonder, not a literal refusal of all inquiry or scientific cosmology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line03.simpleEn: Your vast creation cannot be fully measured or comprehended.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line03.simplePa: ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਰਾ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਕਿਸੇ ਦੇ ਪੂਰੇ ਮਾਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦਾ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line03.interpretiveCaution: The first two lines acknowledge diverse human understandings; the final questions express wonder, not a literal refusal of all inquiry or scientific cosmology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line04.simpleEn: How, indeed, did this world first come into being? The poet wonders.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line04.simplePa: ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਰਚਿਆ ਗਿਆ—ਕਵੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਨਾਲ ਪੁੱਛਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras17.line04.interpretiveCaution: The first two lines acknowledge diverse human understandings; the final questions express wonder, not a literal refusal of all inquiry or scientific cosmology.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line01.simpleEn: The One appears as a single, incomparable Divine reality amid countless forms.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line01.simplePa: ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਉਹ ਇੱਕੋ ਅਨੂਪ ਸਰੂਪ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line01.interpretiveCaution: Four “khanis” are a traditional way of classifying forms of birth: egg, womb, moisture and vegetation; they are not four exhaustive modern biological categories.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line02.simpleEn: At one place a poor person appears, at another a ruler or king.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line02.simplePa: ਕਿਤੇ ਰੰਕ ਤੇ ਕਿਤੇ ਰਾਜਾ ਜਾਂ ਭੂਪ ਦਿੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line02.interpretiveCaution: Four “khanis” are a traditional way of classifying forms of birth: egg, womb, moisture and vegetation; they are not four exhaustive modern biological categories.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line03.simpleEn: The poem names beings born from eggs, wombs and moisture.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line03.simplePa: ਅੰਡਿਆਂ, ਗਰਭਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਨਮੀ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ ਰਵਾਇਤੀ ਜਨਮ-ਭੇਦ ਗਿਣੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line03.interpretiveCaution: Four “khanis” are a traditional way of classifying forms of birth: egg, womb, moisture and vegetation; they are not four exhaustive modern biological categories.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line04.simpleEn: It adds plants or sprouting life as another form of the One’s creation.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line04.simplePa: ਉੱਗਣ ਵਾਲੀ ਬਨਸਪਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ ਦੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਦਾ ਰੂਪ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras18.line04.interpretiveCaution: Four “khanis” are a traditional way of classifying forms of birth: egg, womb, moisture and vegetation; they are not four exhaustive modern biological categories.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line01.simpleEn: In one place the One’s power is pictured as the splendour of a king.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line01.simplePa: ਕਿਤੇ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਖੇਲ ਰਾਜੇ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਾਨ ਵਾਂਗ ਦਿੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line01.interpretiveCaution: These are poetic ways to point beyond fixed worldly form and status. “Sankar” has contextual lexical ambiguity and needs Dasam/Braj collation.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line02.simpleEn: In another, a contracted or ascetic form appears in the poem’s imagery.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line02.simplePa: ਕਿਤੇ ਉਸੇ ਖੇਲ ਦਾ ਸਿਮਟਿਆ ਜਾਂ ਸੰਨਿਆਸੀ ਵਰਗਾ ਰੂਪ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line02.interpretiveCaution: These are poetic ways to point beyond fixed worldly form and status. “Sankar” has contextual lexical ambiguity and needs Dasam/Braj collation.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line03.simpleEn: The whole creation displays an astonishing variety of forms.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line03.simplePa: ਸਾਰੀ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਅਚਰਜ-ਭਰੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਰੂਪ ਵਿਖਾਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line03.interpretiveCaution: These are poetic ways to point beyond fixed worldly form and status. “Sankar” has contextual lexical ambiguity and needs Dasam/Braj collation.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line04.simpleEn: Yet its Source is described as self-existent from the beginning of ages.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line04.simplePa: ਪਰ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਮੂਲ ਆਦਿ-ਜੁਗਾਦਿ ਤੋਂ ਆਪੇ ਹੋਂਦ ਵਾਲਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras19.line04.interpretiveCaution: These are poetic ways to point beyond fixed worldly form and status. “Sankar” has contextual lexical ambiguity and needs Dasam/Braj collation.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line01.simpleEn: Now, O Divine Protector, please shelter me from the dangers before me.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਹੁਣ ਮੇਰੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਕਰ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਸੰਕਟ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਾ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line01.interpretiveCaution: The original includes severe martial words “asikhya”, “dusht” and “malechh”. These are historically charged and can demean religious communities if misapplied. Do not equate contemporary non-Sikhs with enemies, endorse group violence or promise violent divine punishment. Human reviewer REQUIRED.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line02.simpleEn: Protect Sikh followers and overcome those portrayed as resisting or harming them.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line02.simplePa: ਸਿੱਖ ਸੇਵਕਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬਚਾ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਦੇਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਵਿਰੋਧ ਨੂੰ ਰੋਕ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line02.interpretiveCaution: The original includes severe martial words “asikhya”, “dusht” and “malechh”. These are historically charged and can demean religious communities if misapplied. Do not equate contemporary non-Sikhs with enemies, endorse group violence or promise violent divine punishment. Human reviewer REQUIRED.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line03.simpleEn: The poem describes malicious forces that raise conflict and disturbance.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line03.simplePa: ਦੁਸ਼ਟ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਉਪਦ੍ਰਵ ਅਤੇ ਫਸਾਦ ਖੜ੍ਹੇ ਕਰਨ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line03.interpretiveCaution: The original includes severe martial words “asikhya”, “dusht” and “malechh”. These are historically charged and can demean religious communities if misapplied. Do not equate contemporary non-Sikhs with enemies, endorse group violence or promise violent divine punishment. Human reviewer REQUIRED.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line04.simpleEn: Using severe historical battle-language, the poet petitions for the defeat of hostile forces.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line04.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਇਤਿਹਾਸਕ ਜੰਗੀ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਨਾਲ ਵੈਰੀ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਦੇ ਹਾਰਨ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras20.line04.interpretiveCaution: The original includes severe martial words “asikhya”, “dusht” and “malechh”. These are historically charged and can demean religious communities if misapplied. Do not equate contemporary non-Sikhs with enemies, endorse group violence or promise violent divine punishment. Human reviewer REQUIRED.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line01.simpleEn: Those who seek refuge in You, O Asidhuj, place themselves under Your protection.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਅਸਿਧੁਜ, ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a Divine name in this composition. Conflict imagery does not turn other humans into legitimate targets; refuge is the central request.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line02.simpleEn: The poem pictures their hostile persecutors as defeated and distressed.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line02.simplePa: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਸਤਾਉਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਵੈਰੀ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਦੁਖੀ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਹਾਰਦੀਆਂ ਦਿਖਾਈਆਂ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line02.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a Divine name in this composition. Conflict imagery does not turn other humans into legitimate targets; refuge is the central request.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line03.simpleEn: People who bow at Your feet in humble dependence turn toward You.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line03.simplePa: ਜੋ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨਿਮਰਤਾ ਨਾਲ ਤੇਰੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਿਰ ਨਿਵਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a Divine name in this composition. Conflict imagery does not turn other humans into legitimate targets; refuge is the central request.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line04.simpleEn: From their troubles and dangers, You are asked to deliver them.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line04.simplePa: ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਸਭ ਸੰਕਟ ਤੂੰ ਦੂਰ ਕਰ—ਇਹ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras21.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Asidhuj” is a Divine name in this composition. Conflict imagery does not turn other humans into legitimate targets; refuge is the central request.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line01.simpleEn: Whoever remembers the One even once in the difficulties of this age turns toward Divine refuge.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line01.simplePa: ਜੋ ਇਸ ਕਲਿਯੁਗ ਵਿੱਚ ਇੱਕ ਵਾਰ ਵੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਵੱਲ ਮੁੜਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line01.interpretiveCaution: Claims that death or harm cannot approach a devotee are devotional expressions of spiritual protection; they must not be interpreted as clinical immortality, neglect of danger or a replacement for emergency care.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line02.simpleEn: The poet portrays the power of death as unable to draw near that devotee.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line02.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ-ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਾਲ ਦੀ ਤਾਕਤ ਉਸ ਭਗਤ ਦੇ ਨੇੜੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦੀ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line02.interpretiveCaution: Claims that death or harm cannot approach a devotee are devotional expressions of spiritual protection; they must not be interpreted as clinical immortality, neglect of danger or a replacement for emergency care.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line03.simpleEn: That protection is praised as available through all times.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line03.simplePa: ਉਸ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਨੂੰ ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ ਦਾ ਸਹਾਰਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line03.interpretiveCaution: Claims that death or harm cannot approach a devotee are devotional expressions of spiritual protection; they must not be interpreted as clinical immortality, neglect of danger or a replacement for emergency care.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line04.simpleEn: Hostility and harmful misfortune are envisioned as passing away at once.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line04.simplePa: ਵੈਰ ਅਤੇ ਬਿਪਤਾ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਹਟਦੇ ਹੋਏ ਦਿਖਾਏ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras22.line04.interpretiveCaution: Claims that death or harm cannot approach a devotee are devotional expressions of spiritual protection; they must not be interpreted as clinical immortality, neglect of danger or a replacement for emergency care.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line01.simpleEn: The person who receives Your compassionate gaze is remembered in prayer.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line01.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀ ਨਿਗਾਹ ਪੈਂਦੀ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਇੱਥੇ ਯਾਦ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line01.interpretiveCaution: The imagery says distress is lifted and “riddhi/siddhi” granted; it is not a verified promise to cure illness, prevent injury, confer supernatural powers or eliminate financial hardship.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line02.simpleEn: The poem imagines their suffering and burning distress removed in a moment.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line02.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਦੁੱਖ ਅਤੇ ਤਾਪ ਨੂੰ ਪਲ ਭਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਟਦਾ ਦਿਖਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line02.interpretiveCaution: The imagery says distress is lifted and “riddhi/siddhi” granted; it is not a verified promise to cure illness, prevent injury, confer supernatural powers or eliminate financial hardship.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line03.simpleEn: Prosperity and extraordinary gifts are described as present in that household.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line03.simplePa: ਰਿੱਧੀਆਂ-ਸਿੱਧੀਆਂ ਵਰਗੀਆਂ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਉਸ ਘਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ-ਤਸਵੀਰ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line03.interpretiveCaution: The imagery says distress is lifted and “riddhi/siddhi” granted; it is not a verified promise to cure illness, prevent injury, confer supernatural powers or eliminate financial hardship.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line04.simpleEn: No hostile shadow is pictured as able to touch or overwhelm them.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line04.simplePa: ਕੋਈ ਵੈਰੀ ਛਾਂ ਵੀ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਛੂਹ ਨਾ ਸਕੇ—ਅਜੇਹੀ ਰੱਖਿਆ ਦੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras23.line04.interpretiveCaution: The imagery says distress is lifted and “riddhi/siddhi” granted; it is not a verified promise to cure illness, prevent injury, confer supernatural powers or eliminate financial hardship.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line01.simpleEn: Even once remembering You is described as turning a person toward rescue.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line01.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਇੱਕ ਵਾਰ ਵੀ ਤੈਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਇਆ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line01.interpretiveCaution: This stanza uses heightened protective language about death, poverty and hostility. Do not tell a reader that one recitation medically prevents death or automatically fixes debts.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line02.simpleEn: That one is pictured as rescued from death’s noose.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line02.simplePa: ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕਾਲ ਦੇ ਫੰਧੇ ਤੋਂ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line02.interpretiveCaution: This stanza uses heightened protective language about death, poverty and hostility. Do not tell a reader that one recitation medically prevents death or automatically fixes debts.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line03.simpleEn: A person who speaks Your Name seeks its sustaining protection.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line03.simplePa: ਜੋ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮ ਉਚਾਰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਉਸ ਦੇ ਸਹਾਰੇ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line03.interpretiveCaution: This stanza uses heightened protective language about death, poverty and hostility. Do not tell a reader that one recitation medically prevents death or automatically fixes debts.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line04.simpleEn: The poet describes freedom from poverty, harm and moral wrongdoing.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line04.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਦਰਿਦ੍ਰਤਾ, ਦੁਸ਼ਟਤਾ ਅਤੇ ਦੋਖ ਤੋਂ ਛੁਟਕਾਰੇ ਦੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras24.line04.interpretiveCaution: This stanza uses heightened protective language about death, poverty and hostility. Do not tell a reader that one recitation medically prevents death or automatically fixes debts.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line01.simpleEn: O Khargket, I come into Your refuge and seek protection.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਖੜਗਕੇਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਮੈਂ ਤੇਰੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਇਆ ਹਾਂ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line01.interpretiveCaution: Important edition boundary: “ਦੁਸਟ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਚਾਈ” ends the Benti Chaupai excerpt named in the SGPC Rehat Maryada for Rehras and Amrit ceremony. Additional digital candidate pauris 26–29 require separate named provenance. Do NOT silently merge variants.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line02.simpleEn: Stretch forth Your protecting hand and rescue me.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line02.simplePa: ਆਪਣਾ ਹੱਥ ਦੇ ਕੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਬਚਾ ਲਵੋ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line02.interpretiveCaution: Important edition boundary: “ਦੁਸਟ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਚਾਈ” ends the Benti Chaupai excerpt named in the SGPC Rehat Maryada for Rehras and Amrit ceremony. Additional digital candidate pauris 26–29 require separate named provenance. Do NOT silently merge variants.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line03.simpleEn: Be my helper in every place and every circumstance.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line03.simplePa: ਸਭ ਥਾਵਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਹਾਲਾਤਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਮੇਰਾ ਸਹਾਈ ਬਣ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line03.interpretiveCaution: Important edition boundary: “ਦੁਸਟ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਚਾਈ” ends the Benti Chaupai excerpt named in the SGPC Rehat Maryada for Rehras and Amrit ceremony. Additional digital candidate pauris 26–29 require separate named provenance. Do NOT silently merge variants.

chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line04.simpleEn: Deliver me from harmful forces and the suffering they bring.
chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line04.simplePa: ਦੁਸ਼ਟ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੋਖ ਤੋਂ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਬਚਾ।
chaupai|chaupai-rehras25.line04.interpretiveCaution: Important edition boundary: “ਦੁਸਟ ਦੋਖ ਤੇ ਲੇਹੁ ਬਚਾਈ” ends the Benti Chaupai excerpt named in the SGPC Rehat Maryada for Rehras and Amrit ceremony. Additional digital candidate pauris 26–29 require separate named provenance. Do NOT silently merge variants.

chaupai|chaupai-long26.line01.simpleEn: The poet speaks of compassionate grace shown to us by Jagmata, the Mother of the world.
chaupai|chaupai-long26.line01.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਜਗਮਾਤਾ ਵੱਲੋਂ ਸਾਡੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੋਣ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long26.line01.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED SOURCE CANDIDATE, outside the bounded SGPC Rehras excerpt. This stanza explicitly mentions completing a granth and addresses jagmata; its narrative setting and textual boundaries need a named independent Dasam reviewer.

chaupai|chaupai-long26.line02.simpleEn: Under that grace, the work or granth is described as brought to completion on an auspicious night.
chaupai|chaupai-long26.line02.simplePa: ਉਸ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਭ ਰਾਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long26.line02.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED SOURCE CANDIDATE, outside the bounded SGPC Rehras excerpt. This stanza explicitly mentions completing a granth and addresses jagmata; its narrative setting and textual boundaries need a named independent Dasam reviewer.

chaupai|chaupai-long26.line03.simpleEn: The One is praised as removing the moral stains or faults of the body.
chaupai|chaupai-long26.line03.simplePa: ਦੇਹ ਦੇ ਪਾਪ ਅਤੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਦੂਰ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੀ ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long26.line03.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED SOURCE CANDIDATE, outside the bounded SGPC Rehras excerpt. This stanza explicitly mentions completing a granth and addresses jagmata; its narrative setting and textual boundaries need a named independent Dasam reviewer.

chaupai|chaupai-long26.line04.simpleEn: Hostile wickedness and the harm it causes are portrayed as overcome.
chaupai|chaupai-long26.line04.simplePa: ਦੁਰਜਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਦੋਖ ਅਤੇ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਤਾਕਤਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਨਾਸ ਹੋਇਆ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long26.line04.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED SOURCE CANDIDATE, outside the bounded SGPC Rehras excerpt. This stanza explicitly mentions completing a granth and addresses jagmata; its narrative setting and textual boundaries need a named independent Dasam reviewer.

chaupai|chaupai-long27.line01.simpleEn: When the revered Asidhuj became compassionate, says the poet, grace arrived.
chaupai|chaupai-long27.line01.simplePa: ਸ੍ਰੀ ਅਸਿਧੁਜ ਦੇ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਣ ਉੱਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਹੋਈ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long27.line01.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED textual section, not a universal paath requirement. Expressions that all wishes are met and suffering never visits are poetry/devotional promises, not a medical or economic guarantee.

chaupai|chaupai-long27.line02.simpleEn: The granth was then completed without further delay.
chaupai|chaupai-long27.line02.simplePa: ਤਦ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਨੂੰ ਤੁਰੰਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ ਗਿਆ—ਇਸ ਤਰ੍ਹਾਂ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long27.line02.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED textual section, not a universal paath requirement. Expressions that all wishes are met and suffering never visits are poetry/devotional promises, not a medical or economic guarantee.

chaupai|chaupai-long27.line03.simpleEn: The speaker declares that a sincere person receives the fruit longed for in the mind.
chaupai|chaupai-long27.line03.simplePa: ਮਨ ਦੀ ਤਾਂਘ ਵਾਲਾ ਫਲ ਮਿਲਣ ਦੀ ਭਗਤੀ-ਭਰੀ ਗੱਲ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long27.line03.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED textual section, not a universal paath requirement. Expressions that all wishes are met and suffering never visits are poetry/devotional promises, not a medical or economic guarantee.

chaupai|chaupai-long27.line04.simpleEn: The verse depicts that person as free from overwhelming suffering.
chaupai|chaupai-long27.line04.simplePa: ਉਸ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਨੂੰ ਦੁੱਖ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long27.line04.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED textual section, not a universal paath requirement. Expressions that all wishes are met and suffering never visits are poetry/devotional promises, not a medical or economic guarantee.

chaupai|chaupai-long28.line01.simpleEn: The poet declares that even one unable to speak may receive a voice through hearing this composition.
chaupai|chaupai-long28.line01.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਕਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਗੂੰਗਾ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਵੀ ਇਸ ਬਾਣੀ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਣ ਕੇ ਬੋਲਣ ਦੀ ਦਾਤ ਪਾ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long28.line01.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED pauri uses old-form poetic claims about a mute person gaining speech and a person called “mūṛh” gaining wisdom. These are NOT evidence of curing speech disorders, disabilities or neurological illness, and never replace medical or speech-language care.

chaupai|chaupai-long28.line02.simpleEn: One without understanding is likewise pictured as gaining wisdom by listening attentively.
chaupai|chaupai-long28.line02.simplePa: ਧਿਆਨ ਨਾਲ ਸੁਣਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਅਣਜਾਣ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਵੀ ਸਮਝ ਆਉਣ ਦੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long28.line02.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED pauri uses old-form poetic claims about a mute person gaining speech and a person called “mūṛh” gaining wisdom. These are NOT evidence of curing speech disorders, disabilities or neurological illness, and never replace medical or speech-language care.

chaupai|chaupai-long28.line03.simpleEn: Pain, distress and fear are said to remain far from such a person.
chaupai|chaupai-long28.line03.simplePa: ਉਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਤੋਂ ਦੁੱਖ, ਦਰਦ ਅਤੇ ਡਰ ਦੂਰ ਰਹਿਣ ਦੀ ਅਸੀਸ ਵਰਗੀ ਗੱਲ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long28.line03.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED pauri uses old-form poetic claims about a mute person gaining speech and a person called “mūṛh” gaining wisdom. These are NOT evidence of curing speech disorders, disabilities or neurological illness, and never replace medical or speech-language care.

chaupai|chaupai-long28.line04.simpleEn: The poet associates these blessings with reciting the Chaupai even once.
chaupai|chaupai-long28.line04.simplePa: ਇਹ ਦਾਤਾਂ ਇੱਕ ਵਾਰ ਵੀ ਚੌਪਈ ਉਚਾਰਨ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੀਆਂ ਦੱਸੀਆਂ ਗਈਆਂ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-long28.line04.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED pauri uses old-form poetic claims about a mute person gaining speech and a person called “mūṛh” gaining wisdom. These are NOT evidence of curing speech disorders, disabilities or neurological illness, and never replace medical or speech-language care.

chaupai|chaupai-long29.line01.simpleEn: The poet begins stating the year, described as seventeen hundred.
chaupai|chaupai-long29.line01.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਸੰਮਤ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ, ਜਿਸ ਦੀ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ ਸਤਾਰਾਂ ਸੌ ਤੋਂ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long29.line01.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED AUTHORIAL COLOPHON / historical date, NOT a standard prayer for material or medical benefits. The numeral words, Bikrami year, lunar calendrical reckoning and place need named edition/historical review; never silently convert the date.

chaupai|chaupai-long29.line02.simpleEn: A further half hundred and three are added in the traditional date expression.
chaupai|chaupai-long29.line02.simplePa: ਫਿਰ ਉਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਅੱਧਾ ਸੌ ਅਤੇ ਤਿੰਨ ਜੋੜੇ ਦੱਸੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
chaupai|chaupai-long29.line02.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED AUTHORIAL COLOPHON / historical date, NOT a standard prayer for material or medical benefits. The numeral words, Bikrami year, lunar calendrical reckoning and place need named edition/historical review; never silently convert the date.

chaupai|chaupai-long29.line03.simpleEn: The date is described as the eighth bright lunar day of Bhadon, falling on Sunday.
chaupai|chaupai-long29.line03.simplePa: ਭਾਦੋਂ ਸੁਦੀ ਅੱਠਮੀ, ਐਤਵਾਰ—ਇਹ ਤਾਰੀਖ ਇਸ ਤੁਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਿਖੀ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long29.line03.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED AUTHORIAL COLOPHON / historical date, NOT a standard prayer for material or medical benefits. The numeral words, Bikrami year, lunar calendrical reckoning and place need named edition/historical review; never silently convert the date.

chaupai|chaupai-long29.line04.simpleEn: The text states that the granth was completed beside the river Sutlej.
chaupai|chaupai-long29.line04.simplePa: ਸਤਲੁਜ ਦਰਿਆ ਦੇ ਕੰਢੇ ਗ੍ਰੰਥ ਸੰਪੂਰਨ ਕਰਨ ਦਾ ਜ਼ਿਕਰ ਹੈ।
chaupai|chaupai-long29.line04.interpretiveCaution: EXTENDED AUTHORIAL COLOPHON / historical date, NOT a standard prayer for material or medical benefits. The numeral words, Bikrami year, lunar calendrical reckoning and place need named edition/historical review; never silently convert the date.

anand|anand08.line01.simpleEn: O revered One, only the person to whom You grant this gift can truly receive it.
anand|anand08.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਬਾਬਾ, ਜਿਸ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਦਾਤ ਦੇਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਉਹੀ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand08.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Bhana” and “Naam” require source-specific Sikh theological review; receiving grace is not a guarantee of a desired worldly outcome.

anand|anand08.line02.simpleEn: Only those You give to receive it; what power have others to secure it by themselves?
anand|anand08.line02.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਉਹੀ ਪਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ; ਹੋਰ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ਆਪਣੇ ਜ਼ੋਰ ਨਾਲ ਕੀ ਕਰ ਸਕਦੇ ਹਨ?
anand|anand08.line02.interpretiveCaution: “Bhana” and “Naam” require source-specific Sikh theological review; receiving grace is not a guarantee of a desired worldly outcome.

anand|anand08.line03.simpleEn: Some wander confused in many directions, while others are shaped and steadied by Naam.
anand|anand08.line03.simplePa: ਕਈ ਭਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਦਸੀਂ ਪਾਸੀਂ ਭਟਕਦੇ ਹਨ; ਕੁਝ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜ ਕੇ ਸੰਵਰ ਜਾਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand08.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Bhana” and “Naam” require source-specific Sikh theological review; receiving grace is not a guarantee of a desired worldly outcome.

anand|anand08.line04.simpleEn: By the Guru’s grace the mind becomes clear, and those people come to accept Your will.
anand|anand08.line04.simplePa: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਜ਼ਾ ਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਰ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand08.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Bhana” and “Naam” require source-specific Sikh theological review; receiving grace is not a guarantee of a desired worldly outcome.

anand|anand08.line05.simpleEn: Nanak repeats: O Beloved, the person You bless is the one who receives the gift.
anand|anand08.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੜ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਹੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ੇਂ, ਉਹੀ ਇਹ ਦਾਤ ਪਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand08.line05.interpretiveCaution: “Bhana” and “Naam” require source-specific Sikh theological review; receiving grace is not a guarantee of a desired worldly outcome.

anand|anand09.line01.simpleEn: Come, beloved saintly friends; let us speak together of the One who cannot fully be described.
anand|anand09.line01.simplePa: ਆਓ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੰਤੋ, ਅਸੀਂ ਉਸ ਅਕਥ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਕਰੀਏ।
anand|anand09.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Tan man dhan” expresses devotion, not an obligation to transfer money or independence to an unaccountable teacher.

anand|anand09.line02.simpleEn: Let us speak of the Ineffable One—and ask by what doorway this understanding is found.
anand|anand09.line02.simplePa: ਅਕਥ ਦੀ ਕਥਾ ਕਰੀਏ; ਇਹ ਸਮਝ ਕਿਸ ਦੁਆਰ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ, ਇਸ ਦੀ ਭਾਲ ਕਰੀਏ।
anand|anand09.line02.interpretiveCaution: “Tan man dhan” expresses devotion, not an obligation to transfer money or independence to an unaccountable teacher.

anand|anand09.line03.simpleEn: By offering body, mind and possessions to the Guru and following Hukam, one comes to this path.
anand|anand09.line03.simplePa: ਤਨ, ਮਨ ਅਤੇ ਧਨ ਗੁਰੂ ਅੱਗੇ ਸਮਰਪਿਤ ਕਰਕੇ, ਹੁਕਮ ਮੰਨਣ ਨਾਲ ਇਹ ਰਾਹ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand09.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Tan man dhan” expresses devotion, not an obligation to transfer money or independence to an unaccountable teacher.

anand|anand09.line04.simpleEn: Accept the Guru’s teaching and sing the true Bani.
anand|anand09.line04.simplePa: ਗੁਰੂ ਦਾ ਹੁਕਮ ਮੰਨੋ ਅਤੇ ਸੱਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵੋ।
anand|anand09.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Tan man dhan” expresses devotion, not an obligation to transfer money or independence to an unaccountable teacher.

anand|anand09.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says: listen, beloved seekers, and continue sharing this wonder of the Unsayable.
anand|anand09.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਹੇ ਸੰਤੋ, ਸੁਣੋ ਅਤੇ ਅਕਥ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਗੱਲ ਸਾਂਝੀ ਕਰੋ।
anand|anand09.line05.interpretiveCaution: “Tan man dhan” expresses devotion, not an obligation to transfer money or independence to an unaccountable teacher.

anand|anand10.line01.simpleEn: O restless mind, clever strategies alone have never brought this realization.
anand|anand10.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਨ, ਕੇਵਲ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਨਾਲ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਕੀਤੀ।
anand|anand10.line01.interpretiveCaution: The metaphor of being “charmed” does not imply a literal spell, psychiatric disorder or a condemnation of ordinary family life.

anand|anand10.line02.simpleEn: Listen, my mind: cleverness on its own cannot secure the Divine.
anand|anand10.line02.simplePa: ਸੁਣ ਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ, ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਅਕਲ ਦੇ ਚਾਲਾਕ ਢੰਗ ਨਾਲ ਇਹ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਨਹੀਂ ਹੁੰਦਾ।
anand|anand10.line02.interpretiveCaution: The metaphor of being “charmed” does not imply a literal spell, psychiatric disorder or a condemnation of ordinary family life.

anand|anand10.line03.simpleEn: Enchanting Maya can draw people into confusion and make them forget what matters.
anand|anand10.line03.simplePa: ਮੋਹਣੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਨੂੰ ਭਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਾ ਕੇ ਅਸਲ ਮਕਸਦ ਭੁਲਾ ਸਕਦੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand10.line03.interpretiveCaution: The metaphor of being “charmed” does not imply a literal spell, psychiatric disorder or a condemnation of ordinary family life.

anand|anand10.line04.simpleEn: The One who created the world also made Maya’s alluring power.
anand|anand10.line04.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਇਹ ਸ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਟੀ ਰਚੀ, ਉਸੇ ਨੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾ ਮੋਹਕ ਖੇਲ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand10.line04.interpretiveCaution: The metaphor of being “charmed” does not imply a literal spell, psychiatric disorder or a condemnation of ordinary family life.

anand|anand10.line05.simpleEn: The speaker bows in wonder before the One who made this attraction appear so sweet.
anand|anand10.line05.simplePa: ਕਵੀ ਉਸ ਕਰਤਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਸਦਕੇ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਨੇ ਇਹ ਮੋਹ ਇੰਨਾ ਮਿੱਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand10.line05.interpretiveCaution: The metaphor of being “charmed” does not imply a literal spell, psychiatric disorder or a condemnation of ordinary family life.

anand|anand10.line06.simpleEn: Nanak returns to the restless mind: mere cleverness does not bring the deepest understanding.
anand|anand10.line06.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੜ ਚੰਚਲ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਇਕੱਲੀ ਇਹ ਅਸਲ ਸਮਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਿੰਦੀ।
anand|anand10.line06.interpretiveCaution: The metaphor of being “charmed” does not imply a literal spell, psychiatric disorder or a condemnation of ordinary family life.

anand|anand11.line01.simpleEn: O beloved mind, remember the True One continually.
anand|anand11.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨ, ਸਦਾ ਸੱਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਰੱਖ।
anand|anand11.line01.interpretiveCaution: Do not suggest withdrawing care from family; the text contrasts impermanent ties with moral/spiritual guidance.

anand|anand11.line02.simpleEn: The family you see around you does not accompany you after life ends.
anand|anand11.line02.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਉਹ ਮੌਤ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਵੇਗਾ।
anand|anand11.line02.interpretiveCaution: Do not suggest withdrawing care from family; the text contrasts impermanent ties with moral/spiritual guidance.

anand|anand11.line03.simpleEn: Why fasten the whole mind to what cannot accompany you forever?
anand|anand11.line03.simplePa: ਜੋ ਅੰਤ ਤਕ ਨਾਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਜਾਣਾ, ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਮਨ ਦੀ ਸਾਰੀ ਲਗਨ ਕਿਉਂ ਬੰਨ੍ਹੀਏ?
anand|anand11.line03.interpretiveCaution: Do not suggest withdrawing care from family; the text contrasts impermanent ties with moral/spiritual guidance.

anand|anand11.line04.simpleEn: Do not choose actions that will bring remorse at the end.
anand|anand11.line04.simplePa: ਅਜੇਹੇ ਕਰਮ ਨਾ ਕਰ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਲਈ ਅੰਤ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਛਤਾਉਣਾ ਪਵੇ।
anand|anand11.line04.interpretiveCaution: Do not suggest withdrawing care from family; the text contrasts impermanent ties with moral/spiritual guidance.

anand|anand11.line05.simpleEn: Listen to the True Guru’s teaching; it can remain with you.
anand|anand11.line05.simplePa: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦਾ ਉਪਦੇਸ਼ ਸੁਣ, ਇਹੀ ਅਸਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਾਥ ਦੇ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand11.line05.interpretiveCaution: Do not suggest withdrawing care from family; the text contrasts impermanent ties with moral/spiritual guidance.

anand|anand11.line06.simpleEn: Nanak repeats: beloved mind, keep remembering the True One.
anand|anand11.line06.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੜ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਹੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨ, ਸਦਾ ਸੱਚ ਨੂੰ ਸੰਭਾਲ।
anand|anand11.line06.interpretiveCaution: Do not suggest withdrawing care from family; the text contrasts impermanent ties with moral/spiritual guidance.

anand|anand12.line01.simpleEn: You are beyond ordinary reach and senses; no one has discovered Your full limit.
anand|anand12.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਤੂੰ ਅਗਮ ਤੇ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਹੈਂ; ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਅੰਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਿਆ।
anand|anand12.line01.interpretiveCaution: This is reverent poetry about ineffability and Divine presence, not literal statements about human sensory perception or omniscient surveillance.

anand|anand12.line02.simpleEn: Only You know Your own depth and extent; no one else has fully measured it.
anand|anand12.line02.simplePa: ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣਾ ਸਰੂਪ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੈਂ; ਹੋਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਨੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਭਿਆ।
anand|anand12.line02.interpretiveCaution: This is reverent poetry about ineffability and Divine presence, not literal statements about human sensory perception or omniscient surveillance.

anand|anand12.line03.simpleEn: All beings are part of Your creation; how could anyone describe the whole play?
anand|anand12.line03.simplePa: ਸਾਰੇ ਜੀਵ ਤੇਰੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਦੇ ਖੇਲ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਨ; ਉਸ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਵਰਣਨ ਕੌਣ ਕਰ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ?
anand|anand12.line03.interpretiveCaution: This is reverent poetry about ineffability and Divine presence, not literal statements about human sensory perception or omniscient surveillance.

anand|anand12.line04.simpleEn: You speak, behold and pervade creation, O One who brought the world into being.
anand|anand12.line04.simplePa: ਹੇ ਜਗਤ ਦੇ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰ, ਤੂੰ ਹੀ ਬੋਲਣ ਤੇ ਵੇਖਣ ਵਾਲੇ ਹਰ ਰੂਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਿਆਪਕ ਹੈਂ।
anand|anand12.line04.interpretiveCaution: This is reverent poetry about ineffability and Divine presence, not literal statements about human sensory perception or omniscient surveillance.

anand|anand12.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says: You remain forever beyond human reach; Your fullness cannot be exhausted.
anand|anand12.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਤੂੰ ਸਦਾ ਅਗੰਮ ਹੈਂ, ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤ ਕਦੇ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
anand|anand12.line05.interpretiveCaution: This is reverent poetry about ineffability and Divine presence, not literal statements about human sensory perception or omniscient surveillance.

anand|anand13.line01.simpleEn: Divine beings, people and sages seek the life-giving amrit; that nectar is found through the Guru.
anand|anand13.line01.simplePa: ਦੇਵ, ਮਨੁੱਖ ਤੇ ਮੁਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਦੀ ਭਾਲ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ; ਉਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੋਂ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand13.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Amrit” has important Sikh meanings; do not flatten it into an ordinary drink, assert physical immortality or claim the word always has one translation.

anand|anand13.line02.simpleEn: Through the Guru’s grace this amrit is received and the True One comes to dwell within the mind.
anand|anand13.line02.simplePa: ਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਤੀ ਤਾਂ ਇਹ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਤੇ ਸੱਚਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸਿਆ।
anand|anand13.line02.interpretiveCaution: “Amrit” has important Sikh meanings; do not flatten it into an ordinary drink, assert physical immortality or claim the word always has one translation.

anand|anand13.line03.simpleEn: You created all living beings; some are drawn to seeing and encountering the Divine.
anand|anand13.line03.simplePa: ਹੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ, ਸਾਰੇ ਜੀਵ ਤੂੰ ਰਚੇ; ਕਈ ਦਰਸ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਦੀ ਭਾਵਨਾ ਨਾਲ ਆਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand13.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Amrit” has important Sikh meanings; do not flatten it into an ordinary drink, assert physical immortality or claim the word always has one translation.

anand|anand13.line04.simpleEn: Greed, covetousness and ego begin to fall away as the True Guru becomes dear.
anand|anand13.line04.simplePa: ਜਦ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਲੱਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਤਾਂ ਲਾਲਚ, ਲੋਭ ਅਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਘਟਣ ਲੱਗਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand13.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Amrit” has important Sikh meanings; do not flatten it into an ordinary drink, assert physical immortality or claim the word always has one translation.

anand|anand13.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says: the one on whom the Divine is pleased finds this amrit through the Guru.
anand|anand13.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਜਿਸ ਉੱਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਹੋਇਆ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਾਹੀਂ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਮਿਲਿਆ।
anand|anand13.line05.interpretiveCaution: “Amrit” has important Sikh meanings; do not flatten it into an ordinary drink, assert physical immortality or claim the word always has one translation.

anand|anand14.line01.simpleEn: The path and way of devotees is different from the usual path.
anand|anand14.line01.simplePa: ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਜੀਵਨ-ਚਾਲ ਆਮ ਰਸਤੇ ਤੋਂ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand14.line01.interpretiveCaution: The sharp-blade imagery conveys difficulty, not an actual physical task or a test of endurance.

anand|anand14.line02.simpleEn: This unusual way of devotion calls for walking a difficult path.
anand|anand14.line02.simplePa: ਭਗਤੀ ਦੀ ਇਹ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਚਾਲ ਔਖੇ ਮਾਰਗ ਉੱਤੇ ਤੁਰਨ ਦੀ ਮੰਗ ਕਰਦੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand14.line02.interpretiveCaution: The sharp-blade imagery conveys difficulty, not an actual physical task or a test of endurance.

anand|anand14.line03.simpleEn: Leave behind grasping, greed, ego and craving; speak less in empty self-display.
anand|anand14.line03.simplePa: ਲਬ, ਲੋਭ, ਹਉਮੈ ਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਛੱਡੋ ਅਤੇ ਫ਼ਜ਼ੂਲ ਬੋਲ ਘਟਾਓ।
anand|anand14.line03.interpretiveCaution: The sharp-blade imagery conveys difficulty, not an actual physical task or a test of endurance.

anand|anand14.line04.simpleEn: The way is pictured as sharper than a blade and finer than a hair.
anand|anand14.line04.simplePa: ਇਹ ਰਾਹ ਖੰਡੇ ਦੀ ਧਾਰ ਤੋਂ ਵੀ ਤਿੱਖਾ ਤੇ ਵਾਲ ਤੋਂ ਵੀ ਬਾਰੀਕ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand14.line04.interpretiveCaution: The sharp-blade imagery conveys difficulty, not an actual physical task or a test of endurance.

anand|anand14.line05.simpleEn: Through the Guru’s grace, those who loosen self-centredness find their longings absorbed in Hari.
anand|anand14.line05.simplePa: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਆਪਾ ਛੱਡਿਆ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਚਾਹ ਹਰਿ ਵਿੱਚ ਟਿਕੀ।
anand|anand14.line05.interpretiveCaution: The sharp-blade imagery conveys difficulty, not an actual physical task or a test of endurance.

anand|anand14.line06.simpleEn: Nanak says: in every age the devotee’s way remains distinct.
anand|anand14.line06.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਜੁਗਾਂ-ਜੁਗਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਭਗਤਾਂ ਦੀ ਚਾਲ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand14.line06.interpretiveCaution: The sharp-blade imagery conveys difficulty, not an actual physical task or a test of endurance.

anand|anand15.line01.simpleEn: O Sovereign, we move as You direct us; how could we fully know all Your virtues?
anand|anand15.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ, ਜਿਵੇਂ ਤੂੰ ਚਲਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ ਅਸੀਂ ਤਿਵੇਂ ਚੱਲਦੇ ਹਾਂ; ਤੇਰੇ ਸਾਰੇ ਗੁਣ ਕਿਵੇਂ ਜਾਣੀਏ?
anand|anand15.line01.interpretiveCaution: A devotional statement about Hukam does not justify fatalism, abuse, or the refusal to seek needed help.

anand|anand15.line02.simpleEn: Those whom You put upon a path move along that path.
anand|anand15.line02.simplePa: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਰਸਤੇ ਉੱਤੇ ਪਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਉਹ ਉਸੇ ਰਾਹ ਤੁਰਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand15.line02.interpretiveCaution: A devotional statement about Hukam does not justify fatalism, abuse, or the refusal to seek needed help.

anand|anand15.line03.simpleEn: Those whom You join to Naam through grace remember Hari continually.
anand|anand15.line03.simplePa: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਨਾਮ ਨਾਲ ਜੋੜਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਉਹ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand15.line03.interpretiveCaution: A devotional statement about Hukam does not justify fatalism, abuse, or the refusal to seek needed help.

anand|anand15.line04.simpleEn: Those to whom You share Your own teaching find peace through the Guru’s doorway.
anand|anand15.line04.simplePa: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਤੂੰ ਆਪਣੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ, ਉਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਦੁਆਰੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand15.line04.interpretiveCaution: A devotional statement about Hukam does not justify fatalism, abuse, or the refusal to seek needed help.

anand|anand15.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says: O True Sovereign, You guide beings as it pleases You.
anand|anand15.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਹੇ ਸੱਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ, ਆਪਣੀ ਰਜ਼ਾ ਅਨੁਸਾਰ ਤੂੰ ਜੀਵਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਰਾਹ ਦਿਖਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈਂ।
anand|anand15.line05.interpretiveCaution: A devotional statement about Hukam does not justify fatalism, abuse, or the refusal to seek needed help.

anand|anand16.line01.simpleEn: This beautiful Sohila is the Guru’s lovely Shabad.
anand|anand16.line01.simplePa: ਇਹ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਾ ਸੋਹਣਾ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਹੈ।
anand|anand16.line01.interpretiveCaution: The word “sohila” does not by itself refer to the whole night Nitnem composition; keep exact source occurrence attribution.

anand|anand16.line02.simpleEn: The True Guru has caused this enduring song of praise to be heard.
anand|anand16.line02.simplePa: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਇਹ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸ਼ਬਦ-ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand16.line02.interpretiveCaution: The word “sohila” does not by itself refer to the whole night Nitnem composition; keep exact source occurrence attribution.

anand|anand16.line03.simpleEn: It comes to dwell within the minds of those for whom this grace has been written.
anand|anand16.line03.simplePa: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਧੁਰੋਂ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮਿਲੀ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand16.line03.interpretiveCaution: The word “sohila” does not by itself refer to the whole night Nitnem composition; keep exact source occurrence attribution.

anand|anand16.line04.simpleEn: Some wander and talk endlessly, but mere talk does not bring the experience.
anand|anand16.line04.simplePa: ਕਈ ਬਹੁਤ ਭਟਕਦੇ ਤੇ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਸਿਰਫ਼ ਗੱਲਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਇਹ ਅਨੁਭਵ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲਦਾ।
anand|anand16.line04.interpretiveCaution: The word “sohila” does not by itself refer to the whole night Nitnem composition; keep exact source occurrence attribution.

anand|anand16.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says: this true Sohila and Shabad were made known through the True Guru.
anand|anand16.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਨੇ ਇਹ ਸੱਚਾ ਸ਼ਬਦ-ਸੋਹਿਲਾ ਸੁਣਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand16.line05.interpretiveCaution: The word “sohila” does not by itself refer to the whole night Nitnem composition; keep exact source occurrence attribution.

anand|anand17.line01.simpleEn: Those who remember Hari are described as becoming inwardly pure.
anand|anand17.line01.simplePa: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ, ਉਹ ਅੰਦਰੋਂ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਹੋਏ ਦੱਸੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
anand|anand17.line01.interpretiveCaution: The extended family-purity image is not a claim about inherited virtue, caste, ritual exclusion or automatic health outcomes.

anand|anand17.line02.simpleEn: Through Guru-oriented remembrance, their lives become purified.
anand|anand17.line02.simplePa: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਨੂੰ ਧਿਆਉਣ ਨਾਲ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਜੀਵਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਪਵਿੱਤਰਤਾ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand17.line02.interpretiveCaution: The extended family-purity image is not a claim about inherited virtue, caste, ritual exclusion or automatic health outcomes.

anand|anand17.line03.simpleEn: Their family, parents and the whole sangat are pictured as sharing in this goodness.
anand|anand17.line03.simplePa: ਮਾਤਾ, ਪਿਤਾ, ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਅਤੇ ਸਾਰੀ ਸੰਗਤ ਤੱਕ ਇਸ ਚੰਗਿਆਈ ਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵ ਪਹੁੰਚਦਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand17.line03.interpretiveCaution: The extended family-purity image is not a claim about inherited virtue, caste, ritual exclusion or automatic health outcomes.

anand|anand17.line04.simpleEn: Those who speak, listen and hold Hari within the mind are named pure.
anand|anand17.line04.simplePa: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਦੀ ਸਿਫ਼ਤ ਕਹਿੰਦੇ, ਸੁਣਦੇ ਅਤੇ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਸਾਉਂਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਕਹੇ ਗਏ ਹਨ।
anand|anand17.line04.interpretiveCaution: The extended family-purity image is not a claim about inherited virtue, caste, ritual exclusion or automatic health outcomes.

anand|anand17.line05.simpleEn: Nanak repeats that Guru-oriented remembrance of Hari purifies a person.
anand|anand17.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੜ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਹਰਿ ਦਾ ਧਿਆਨ ਕਰਨ ਵਾਲੇ ਪਵਿੱਤਰ ਹੁੰਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand17.line05.interpretiveCaution: The extended family-purity image is not a claim about inherited virtue, caste, ritual exclusion or automatic health outcomes.

anand|anand18.line01.simpleEn: Inner steadiness is not produced through outward religious actions alone; without Sahaj, doubt remains.
anand|anand18.line01.simplePa: ਕੇਵਲ ਬਾਹਰਲੇ ਕਰਮਾਂ ਨਾਲ ਸਹਜ ਨਹੀਂ ਆਉਂਦਾ; ਸਹਜ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਮਨ ਦਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਬਣਿਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand18.line01.interpretiveCaution: The cleansing imagery is spiritual, not a prescription for physical purification rituals or psychiatric care.

anand|anand18.line02.simpleEn: Many perform practices and restraints, but the deep uncertainty still does not disappear.
anand|anand18.line02.simplePa: ਲੋਕ ਅਨੇਕ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਦੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ ਸੰਸਾ ਇਉਂ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਟਦਾ।
anand|anand18.line02.interpretiveCaution: The cleansing imagery is spiritual, not a prescription for physical purification rituals or psychiatric care.

anand|anand18.line03.simpleEn: Doubt troubles and clouds the living mind; what practice could really wash it away?
anand|anand18.line03.simplePa: ਸੰਸਾ ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਮੈਲਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ; ਕਿਹੜੇ ਸੰਜਮ ਨਾਲ ਇਸ ਦੀ ਅਸਲ ਮੈਲ ਧੋਤੀ ਜਾਵੇ?
anand|anand18.line03.interpretiveCaution: The cleansing imagery is spiritual, not a prescription for physical purification rituals or psychiatric care.

anand|anand18.line04.simpleEn: Cleanse the mind by attaching yourself to the Shabad and keeping attention on Hari.
anand|anand18.line04.simplePa: ਸ਼ਬਦ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੋ, ਮਨ ਨੂੰ ਸੁੱਚਾ ਕਰੋ ਅਤੇ ਚਿੱਤ ਹਰਿ ਵਿੱਚ ਲਗਾਈ ਰੱਖੋ।
anand|anand18.line04.interpretiveCaution: The cleansing imagery is spiritual, not a prescription for physical purification rituals or psychiatric care.

anand|anand18.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says Sahaj arises through the Guru’s grace, and in that way the doubt leaves.
anand|anand18.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਸਹਜ ਜਾਗਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਇਉਂ ਸੰਸਾ ਦੂਰ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand18.line05.interpretiveCaution: The cleansing imagery is spiritual, not a prescription for physical purification rituals or psychiatric care.

anand|anand19.line01.simpleEn: One may appear pure on the outside while the inner life remains stained.
anand|anand19.line01.simplePa: ਮਨੁੱਖ ਬਾਹਰੋਂ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਦਿੱਸ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ ਪਰ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ ਮਨ ਮੈਲਾ ਰਹਿ ਸਕਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand19.line01.interpretiveCaution: A high-stakes spiritual metaphor about gambling is not a judgment of a real person’s mental health, worth or medical treatment.

anand|anand19.line02.simpleEn: Such an outwardly clean yet inwardly troubled life is likened to losing a precious birth in gambling.
anand|anand19.line02.simplePa: ਬਾਹਰਲੀ ਸੁਚਾਈ ਹੋਵੇ ਪਰ ਅੰਦਰ ਮੈਲ ਹੋਵੇ ਤਾਂ ਕੀਮਤੀ ਜਨਮ ਜੂਏ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਾਰਨ ਵਰਗੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਹੈ।
anand|anand19.line02.interpretiveCaution: A high-stakes spiritual metaphor about gambling is not a judgment of a real person’s mental health, worth or medical treatment.

anand|anand19.line03.simpleEn: Craving is described as a great inner affliction, while the person forgets that life will end.
anand|anand19.line03.simplePa: ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਨੂੰ ਵੱਡਾ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ ਰੋਗ ਕਿਹਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਆਪਣੀ ਮਰਣਹਾਰਤਾ ਭੁੱਲ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand19.line03.interpretiveCaution: A high-stakes spiritual metaphor about gambling is not a judgment of a real person’s mental health, worth or medical treatment.

anand|anand19.line04.simpleEn: Even though Naam is held highest within religious teaching, some do not listen and wander aimlessly.
anand|anand19.line04.simplePa: ਧਾਰਮਿਕ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਨਾਮ ਉੱਤਮ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ, ਪਰ ਕੁਝ ਸੁਣਦੇ ਨਹੀਂ ਤੇ ਭਟਕਦੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand19.line04.interpretiveCaution: A high-stakes spiritual metaphor about gambling is not a judgment of a real person’s mental health, worth or medical treatment.

anand|anand19.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says that abandoning Truth for falsehood is like gambling away life’s opportunity.
anand|anand19.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਸੱਚ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ ਕੂੜ ਨਾਲ ਲੱਗਣਾ ਕੀਮਤੀ ਜੀਵਨ ਜੂਏ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਾਰਨ ਵਰਗਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand19.line05.interpretiveCaution: A high-stakes spiritual metaphor about gambling is not a judgment of a real person’s mental health, worth or medical treatment.

anand|anand20.line01.simpleEn: A person becomes pure inwardly and outwardly when life is aligned with Truth.
anand|anand20.line01.simplePa: ਜਦ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਦਾ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ ਜੀਵਨ ਅਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਲਾ ਆਚਰਨ ਸੱਚ ਨਾਲ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand20.line01.interpretiveCaution: The ethical/inner purity metaphor does not define social status, medical health or a right to exclude others.

anand|anand20.line02.simpleEn: True inner and outward purity arises through living the teaching received from the True Guru.
anand|anand20.line02.simplePa: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਮੁਤਾਬਕ ਕਰਣੀ ਕਰਨ ਨਾਲ ਅੰਦਰ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰ ਦੋਹਾਂ ਪਾਸੇ ਸੁਚਾਈ ਆਉਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand20.line02.interpretiveCaution: The ethical/inner purity metaphor does not define social status, medical health or a right to exclude others.

anand|anand20.line03.simpleEn: Falsehood cannot take hold there, for the mind’s intention is absorbed in Truth.
anand|anand20.line03.simplePa: ਜਿਥੇ ਮਨ ਦਾ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਸੱਚ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਹੈ, ਉਥੇ ਕੂੜ ਦੀ ਪਹੁੰਚ ਨਹੀਂ ਬਣਦੀ।
anand|anand20.line03.interpretiveCaution: The ethical/inner purity metaphor does not define social status, medical health or a right to exclude others.

anand|anand20.line04.simpleEn: Those who make good use of the jewel of human birth are called worthy traders.
anand|anand20.line04.simplePa: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੇ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੇ ਰਤਨ ਨੂੰ ਸਾਰਥਕ ਕੀਤਾ, ਉਹ ਚੰਗੇ ਵਣਜਾਰੇ ਆਖੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand20.line04.interpretiveCaution: The ethical/inner purity metaphor does not define social status, medical health or a right to exclude others.

anand|anand20.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says that people whose minds are clear remain near the Guru in spirit.
anand|anand20.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦਾ ਮਨ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਸਦਾ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand20.line05.interpretiveCaution: The ethical/inner purity metaphor does not define social status, medical health or a right to exclude others.

anand|anand21.line01.simpleEn: When a Sikh truly turns toward the Guru, that person becomes Guru-facing in life.
anand|anand21.line01.simplePa: ਜਦੋਂ ਕੋਈ ਸਿੱਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਵੱਲ ਸੱਚੇ ਦਿਲ ਨਾਲ ਮੁੜਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand21.line01.interpretiveCaution: The Guru’s feet are a symbol of humble learning and refuge, not a mandatory physical gesture to another person.

anand|anand21.line02.simpleEn: To be genuinely Guru-facing is to keep the Guru close within the heart.
anand|anand21.line02.simplePa: ਅਸਲ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਿੱਖ ਮਨੋਂ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜਿਆ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand21.line02.interpretiveCaution: The Guru’s feet are a symbol of humble learning and refuge, not a mandatory physical gesture to another person.

anand|anand21.line03.simpleEn: That Sikh remembers the Guru’s feet inwardly, holding the teaching in the heart and soul.
anand|anand21.line03.simplePa: ਉਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਚਰਨਾਂ ਦੀ ਯਾਦ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਤੇ ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਵਸਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand21.line03.interpretiveCaution: The Guru’s feet are a symbol of humble learning and refuge, not a mandatory physical gesture to another person.

anand|anand21.line04.simpleEn: Letting go of selfish pride, the Sikh remains under the Guru’s refuge and seeks no higher guide.
anand|anand21.line04.simplePa: ਆਪਾ-ਭਾਵ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ ਉਹ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਤੇ ਹੋਰ ਅੰਤਿਮ ਆਸਰਾ ਨਹੀਂ ਭਾਲਦਾ।
anand|anand21.line04.interpretiveCaution: The Guru’s feet are a symbol of humble learning and refuge, not a mandatory physical gesture to another person.

anand|anand21.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says: listen, seekers—such is the Sikh who genuinely faces the Guru.
anand|anand21.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਹੇ ਸੰਤੋ, ਇਹੀ ਸੱਚਾ ਸਨਮੁਖ ਸਿੱਖ ਹੈ।
anand|anand21.line05.interpretiveCaution: The Guru’s feet are a symbol of humble learning and refuge, not a mandatory physical gesture to another person.

anand|anand22.line01.simpleEn: One who turns away from the Guru is described as unable to find liberation without the True Guru.
anand|anand22.line01.simplePa: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੂ ਤੋਂ ਵੇਮੁਖ ਹੁੰਦਾ ਹੈ, ਬਾਣੀ ਕਹਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ ਕਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾਂਦਾ।
anand|anand22.line01.interpretiveCaution: The imagery of repeated births is a Sikh religious teaching, not a scientifically established description of every individual’s fate.

anand|anand22.line02.simpleEn: Seek the counsel of discerning people: liberation is not found through another shortcut.
anand|anand22.line02.simplePa: ਬਿਬੇਕ ਵਾਲਿਆਂ ਤੋਂ ਪੁੱਛੋ; ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸੇਧ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਹੋਰ ਸੌਖਾ ਰਸਤਾ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਨਹੀਂ ਦਿੰਦਾ।
anand|anand22.line02.interpretiveCaution: The imagery of repeated births is a Sikh religious teaching, not a scientifically established description of every individual’s fate.

anand|anand22.line03.simpleEn: Without the True Guru, the person is pictured wandering in confusion through many births.
anand|anand22.line03.simplePa: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਜੀਵ ਨੂੰ ਭਰਮ ਤੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਜੂਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਭਟਕਦਾ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand22.line03.interpretiveCaution: The imagery of repeated births is a Sikh religious teaching, not a scientifically established description of every individual’s fate.

anand|anand22.line04.simpleEn: Turning again toward the Guru’s feet, and listening to the Shabad, opens the way to liberation.
anand|anand22.line04.simplePa: ਮੁੜ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸ਼ਰਨ ਆ ਕੇ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਸੁਣ ਕੇ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਰਾਹ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand22.line04.interpretiveCaution: The imagery of repeated births is a Sikh religious teaching, not a scientifically established description of every individual’s fate.

anand|anand22.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says: reflect carefully—the Guru’s guidance is central to this release.
anand|anand22.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਵਿਚਾਰ ਕੇ ਦੇਖੋ, ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਸੇਧ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਲਈ ਕੇਂਦਰੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand22.line05.interpretiveCaution: The imagery of repeated births is a Sikh religious teaching, not a scientifically established description of every individual’s fate.

anand|anand23.line01.simpleEn: Come, beloved Sikhs of the True Guru, and sing the true Bani.
anand|anand23.line01.simplePa: ਆਓ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਿੱਖੋ, ਸੱਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵੋ।
anand|anand23.line01.interpretiveCaution: The divine name Sarangpani has a traditional theological history that warrants qualified Sikh/Punjabi lexical review.

anand|anand23.line02.simpleEn: Sing the Guru’s Bani, praised here as highest among teachings.
anand|anand23.line02.simplePa: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਗਾਵੋ, ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਇਸ ਪਉੜੀ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਉੱਚਾ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand23.line02.interpretiveCaution: The divine name Sarangpani has a traditional theological history that warrants qualified Sikh/Punjabi lexical review.

anand|anand23.line03.simpleEn: For those blessed by Divine grace, this Bani comes to dwell within the heart.
anand|anand23.line03.simplePa: ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰਮ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ, ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਵੱਸਦੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand23.line03.interpretiveCaution: The divine name Sarangpani has a traditional theological history that warrants qualified Sikh/Punjabi lexical review.

anand|anand23.line04.simpleEn: Drink the spiritual amrit, remain coloured in Hari’s love and remember Sarangpani.
anand|anand23.line04.simplePa: ਆਤਮਕ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਪੀਓ, ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ-ਰੰਗ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹੋ ਤੇ ਸਾਰਿਗਪਾਣੀ ਨੂੰ ਸਿਮਰੋ।
anand|anand23.line04.interpretiveCaution: The divine name Sarangpani has a traditional theological history that warrants qualified Sikh/Punjabi lexical review.

anand|anand23.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says: continue singing this true Bani.
anand|anand23.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਇਹ ਸੱਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਦਾ ਗਾਉਂਦੇ ਰਹੋ।
anand|anand23.line05.interpretiveCaution: The divine name Sarangpani has a traditional theological history that warrants qualified Sikh/Punjabi lexical review.

anand|anand25.line01.simpleEn: The Guru’s Shabad is a jewel, described as set with precious diamonds.
anand|anand25.line01.simplePa: ਗੁਰੂ ਦਾ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਹੀਰਾ-ਜੜਿਆ ਕੀਮਤੀ ਰਤਨ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand25.line01.interpretiveCaution: The jewel imagery is poetic and does not imply selling physical objects or paywalling Gurbani.

anand|anand25.line02.simpleEn: When the mind becomes attached to this precious Shabad, it enters a deeply fitting relationship.
anand|anand25.line02.simplePa: ਜਦ ਮਨ ਸ਼ਬਦ-ਰਤਨ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਅੰਦਰਲਾ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand25.line02.interpretiveCaution: The jewel imagery is poetic and does not imply selling physical objects or paywalling Gurbani.

anand|anand25.line03.simpleEn: The mind meeting the Shabad comes to love the True One.
anand|anand25.line03.simplePa: ਸ਼ਬਦ ਨਾਲ ਮਨ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਾਂ ਸੱਚੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਲ ਪਿਆਰ ਬਣਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand25.line03.interpretiveCaution: The jewel imagery is poetic and does not imply selling physical objects or paywalling Gurbani.

anand|anand25.line04.simpleEn: The Divine is both the jewel and the precious stone, making this known to those granted understanding.
anand|anand25.line04.simplePa: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪ ਹੀਰਾ ਤੇ ਰਤਨ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਸਮਝ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਇਹ ਜਾਣਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand25.line04.interpretiveCaution: The jewel imagery is poetic and does not imply selling physical objects or paywalling Gurbani.

anand|anand25.line05.simpleEn: Nanak repeats: the Guru’s Shabad is a diamond-studded jewel.
anand|anand25.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੜ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਗੁਰੂ ਦਾ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਹੀਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਜੜਿਆ ਰਤਨ ਹੈ।
anand|anand25.line05.interpretiveCaution: The jewel imagery is poetic and does not imply selling physical objects or paywalling Gurbani.

anand|anand26.line01.simpleEn: The Creator brought forth the relationship of Shiva and Shakti and set Hukam into motion.
anand|anand26.line01.simplePa: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਨੇ ਸਿਵ-ਸ਼ਕਤੀ ਦੀ ਰਚਨਾ ਕਰ ਕੇ ਆਪਣਾ ਹੁਕਮ ਵਰਤਾਇਆ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand26.line01.interpretiveCaution: Release from bondage is a religious image, not a statement about legally or medically removing a person’s constraints.

anand|anand26.line02.simpleEn: The One enacts and witnesses Hukam, revealing its meaning to some through Guru-oriented awareness.
anand|anand26.line02.simplePa: ਉਹ ਆਪ ਹੁਕਮ ਵਰਤਾਉਂਦਾ ਤੇ ਵੇਖਦਾ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਨੂੰ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਸਮਝ ਬਖ਼ਸ਼ਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand26.line02.interpretiveCaution: Release from bondage is a religious image, not a statement about legally or medically removing a person’s constraints.

anand|anand26.line03.simpleEn: Bondage breaks and freedom becomes possible when the Shabad comes to dwell in the mind.
anand|anand26.line03.simplePa: ਜਦ ਸ਼ਬਦ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ, ਬੰਧਨ ਟੁੱਟਦੇ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤੀ ਦਾ ਰਾਹ ਖੁੱਲ੍ਹਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand26.line03.interpretiveCaution: Release from bondage is a religious image, not a statement about legally or medically removing a person’s constraints.

anand|anand26.line04.simpleEn: Those whom the One makes Guru-oriented come to focus their love upon the One.
anand|anand26.line04.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਨੂੰ ਉਹ ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਬਣਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਦੀ ਲਿਵ ਇੱਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨਾਲ ਜੁੜਦੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand26.line04.interpretiveCaution: Release from bondage is a religious image, not a statement about legally or medically removing a person’s constraints.

anand|anand26.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says: the Creator alone makes Hukam understood.
anand|anand26.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਆਪਣੇ ਹੁਕਮ ਦੀ ਸੂਝ ਦਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand26.line05.interpretiveCaution: Release from bondage is a religious image, not a statement about legally or medically removing a person’s constraints.

anand|anand27.line01.simpleEn: Scriptures and codes discuss merit and wrongdoing, yet their discussions alone do not uncover the deepest essence.
anand|anand27.line01.simplePa: ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤੀਆਂ ਤੇ ਸ਼ਾਸਤਰ ਪੁੰਨ-ਪਾਪ ਦੀ ਚਰਚਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਪਰ ਕੇਵਲ ਚਰਚਾ ਨਾਲ ਤੱਤ ਦੀ ਸਾਰ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲਦੀ।
anand|anand27.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Awake all night” is spiritual vigilance imagery, not instruction to deprive oneself of sleep.

anand|anand27.line02.simpleEn: Without the Guru, the essential understanding remains unknown.
anand|anand27.line02.simplePa: ਗੁਰੂ ਤੋਂ ਬਿਨਾਂ ਅਸਲ ਤੱਤ ਦੀ ਸੂਝ ਨਹੀਂ ਪੈਂਦੀ।
anand|anand27.line02.interpretiveCaution: “Awake all night” is spiritual vigilance imagery, not instruction to deprive oneself of sleep.

anand|anand27.line03.simpleEn: The world is pictured asleep in confusion through the three qualities as the night of life passes.
anand|anand27.line03.simplePa: ਤਿੰਨ ਗੁਣਾਂ ਦੇ ਭਰਮ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸੁੱਤਾ ਰਹਿੰਦਾ ਹੈ ਤੇ ਜੀਵਨ ਦੀ ਰਾਤ ਲੰਘਦੀ ਜਾਂਦੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand27.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Awake all night” is spiritual vigilance imagery, not instruction to deprive oneself of sleep.

anand|anand27.line04.simpleEn: Through the Guru’s grace, those whose minds hold Hari awaken and speak life-giving Bani.
anand|anand27.line04.simplePa: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਰਿ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਜਾਗਦੇ ਤੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਬੋਲਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand27.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Awake all night” is spiritual vigilance imagery, not instruction to deprive oneself of sleep.

anand|anand27.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says the essence is found by those who remain lovingly attentive to Hari through day and night.
anand|anand27.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਜੋ ਹਰ ਵੇਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੀ ਲਿਵ ਵਿੱਚ ਜਾਗਦੇ ਰਹਿੰਦੇ ਹਨ, ਉਹ ਤੱਤ ਨੂੰ ਪਛਾਣਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand27.line05.interpretiveCaution: “Awake all night” is spiritual vigilance imagery, not instruction to deprive oneself of sleep.

anand|anand28.line01.simpleEn: Why forget the One who cared for you even within your mother’s womb?
anand|anand28.line01.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੇ ਮਾਂ ਦੇ ਗਰਭ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੰਭਾਲ ਕੀਤੀ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਉਂ ਭੁੱਲੀਏ?
anand|anand28.line01.interpretiveCaution: Pregnancy imagery does not constitute medical guidance or a description of fetal physiology.

anand|anand28.line02.simpleEn: Why forget so great a Giver, who supplied nourishment amid the womb’s fiery imagery?
anand|anand28.line02.simplePa: ਇੰਨੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਕਿਉਂ ਵਿਸਾਰੀਏ, ਜੋ ਗਰਭ ਦੀ ਅੱਗ ਵਾਲੀ ਤਸਵੀਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੀ ਆਹਾਰ ਪਹੁੰਚਾਉਂਦਾ ਹੈ?
anand|anand28.line02.interpretiveCaution: Pregnancy imagery does not constitute medical guidance or a description of fetal physiology.

anand|anand28.line03.simpleEn: The one whom the Divine joins to loving remembrance is pictured as protected from harm.
anand|anand28.line03.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਜੀਵ ਨੂੰ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪਣੀ ਲਿਵ ਨਾਲ ਜੋੜਦਾ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਨੁਕਸਾਨ ਤੋਂ ਬਚਿਆ ਹੋਇਆ ਦੱਸਿਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand28.line03.interpretiveCaution: Pregnancy imagery does not constitute medical guidance or a description of fetal physiology.

anand|anand28.line04.simpleEn: The One itself gives this attunement; through the Guru, continue remembering.
anand|anand28.line04.simplePa: ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਆਪ ਹੀ ਲਿਵ ਜੋੜਦਾ ਹੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖ ਹੋ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਨੂੰ ਸਦਾ ਯਾਦ ਰੱਖ।
anand|anand28.line04.interpretiveCaution: Pregnancy imagery does not constitute medical guidance or a description of fetal physiology.

anand|anand28.line05.simpleEn: Nanak repeats: why forget such a generous Giver?
anand|anand28.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੜ ਪੁੱਛਦੇ ਹਨ: ਇੰਨੇ ਵੱਡੇ ਦਾਤਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਮਨੋਂ ਕਿਉਂ ਭੁਲਾਈਏ?
anand|anand28.line05.interpretiveCaution: Pregnancy imagery does not constitute medical guidance or a description of fetal physiology.

anand|anand29.line01.simpleEn: The fire pictured inside the womb is compared with Maya’s compelling fire in the world outside.
anand|anand29.line01.simplePa: ਗਰਭ ਦੇ ਅੰਦਰਲੀ ਅੱਗ ਦੀ ਤੁਲਨਾ ਬਾਹਰਲੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੀ ਅੱਗ ਨਾਲ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand29.line01.interpretiveCaution: “Fire” and “Maya” remain spiritual imagery; no literal temperature, fetal trauma or clinical mechanism is being described.

anand|anand29.line02.simpleEn: The Creator arranged this poetic play, making both kinds of burning appear alike.
anand|anand29.line02.simplePa: ਕਰਤਾਰ ਨੇ ਇਹ ਖੇਲ ਰਚਿਆ ਹੈ; ਦੋਹਾਂ ਅੱਗਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਇਕੋ ਜਿਹਾ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand29.line02.interpretiveCaution: “Fire” and “Maya” remain spiritual imagery; no literal temperature, fetal trauma or clinical mechanism is being described.

anand|anand29.line03.simpleEn: When it pleased the One, the child was born and welcomed affectionately by family.
anand|anand29.line03.simplePa: ਜਦ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਰਜ਼ਾ ਹੋਈ, ਜੀਵ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਪਰਿਵਾਰ ਨੂੰ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਲੱਗਾ।
anand|anand29.line03.interpretiveCaution: “Fire” and “Maya” remain spiritual imagery; no literal temperature, fetal trauma or clinical mechanism is being described.

anand|anand29.line04.simpleEn: The loving inward connection loosens and a thirst for Maya and craving begins to govern life.
anand|anand29.line04.simplePa: ਅੰਦਰਲੀ ਲਿਵ ਛੁੱਟਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਤੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਦਾ ਮੋਹ ਮਨ ਉੱਤੇ ਹਾਵੀ ਹੋ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand29.line04.interpretiveCaution: “Fire” and “Maya” remain spiritual imagery; no literal temperature, fetal trauma or clinical mechanism is being described.

anand|anand29.line05.simpleEn: Maya is the attachment that makes one forget Hari and turn toward a second, competing love.
anand|anand29.line05.simplePa: ਇਹ ਉਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਹੈ ਜਿਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਹਰਿ ਭੁੱਲ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਤੇ ਦੂਜੇ ਮੋਹ ਨਾਲ ਮਨ ਜੁੜ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand29.line05.interpretiveCaution: “Fire” and “Maya” remain spiritual imagery; no literal temperature, fetal trauma or clinical mechanism is being described.

anand|anand29.line06.simpleEn: Nanak says those joined to Hari through Guru’s grace discover a path even while living amid Maya.
anand|anand29.line06.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੀ ਲਿਵ ਜੁੜਦੀ ਹੈ, ਉਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿੱਚ ਰਹਿ ਕੇ ਵੀ ਰਾਹ ਲੱਭ ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ।
anand|anand29.line06.interpretiveCaution: “Fire” and “Maya” remain spiritual imagery; no literal temperature, fetal trauma or clinical mechanism is being described.

anand|anand30.line01.simpleEn: Hari is beyond price; no one can fully determine the worth of the Divine.
anand|anand30.line01.simplePa: ਹਰਿ ਆਪ ਅਮੁਲਕ ਹੈ; ਕੋਈ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੁੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਪਾ ਸਕਦਾ।
anand|anand30.line01.interpretiveCaution: The symbol of surrender is devotional, not authorization to injure oneself or obey unsafe human commands.

anand|anand30.line02.simpleEn: No human can set that price, even when many remain anxious to measure it.
anand|anand30.line02.simplePa: ਕੋਈ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਮੁੱਲ ਨਹੀਂ ਲੱਭ ਸਕਦਾ, ਭਾਵੇਂ ਲੋਕ ਕੋਸ਼ਿਸ਼ ਕਰਦੇ ਫਿਰਨ।
anand|anand30.line02.interpretiveCaution: The symbol of surrender is devotional, not authorization to injure oneself or obey unsafe human commands.

anand|anand30.line03.simpleEn: If one meets such a True Guru, offer one’s pride and self-importance, letting the ego fall away.
anand|anand30.line03.simplePa: ਅਜਿਹਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਮਿਲੇ ਤਾਂ ਆਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਛੱਡ ਕੇ ਉਸ ਦੀ ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਅੱਗੇ ਨਿਮਰ ਹੋਈਏ।
anand|anand30.line03.interpretiveCaution: The symbol of surrender is devotional, not authorization to injure oneself or obey unsafe human commands.

anand|anand30.line04.simpleEn: The life given by the Divine remains united with its true Source, and Hari comes to dwell within the mind.
anand|anand30.line04.simplePa: ਜਿਸ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਾ ਇਹ ਜੀਵਨ ਹੈ, ਉਸ ਨਾਲ ਮਨ ਜੁੜਦਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand30.line04.interpretiveCaution: The symbol of surrender is devotional, not authorization to injure oneself or obey unsafe human commands.

anand|anand30.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says the fortunate are those who receive the priceless Hari in their lives.
anand|anand30.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਭਾਗਾਂ ਵਾਲੇ ਉਹ ਹਨ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਅਮੁਲਕ ਹਰਿ ਦੀ ਦਾਤ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand30.line05.interpretiveCaution: The symbol of surrender is devotional, not authorization to injure oneself or obey unsafe human commands.

anand|anand31.line01.simpleEn: Hari is my true capital and my mind is a trader who seeks it.
anand|anand31.line01.simplePa: ਹਰਿ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਮੇਰੀ ਅਸਲ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand31.line01.interpretiveCaution: Trading and earnings refer to remembrance and ethical living, not money, investment advice or religious merchandise.

anand|anand31.line02.simpleEn: From the True Guru I learned that Hari is this precious capital for the mind’s trade.
anand|anand31.line02.simplePa: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਤੋਂ ਸਮਝ ਆਈ ਕਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਹੀ ਮਨ ਦੀ ਅਸਲੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ।
anand|anand31.line02.interpretiveCaution: Trading and earnings refer to remembrance and ethical living, not money, investment advice or religious merchandise.

anand|anand31.line03.simpleEn: Remember Hari each day and earn the spiritual profit of remembrance in daily life.
anand|anand31.line03.simplePa: ਹਰ ਰੋਜ਼ ਹਰਿ ਨੂੰ ਯਾਦ ਕਰਕੇ ਆਤਮਕ ਲਾਹਾ ਖੱਟੋ।
anand|anand31.line03.interpretiveCaution: Trading and earnings refer to remembrance and ethical living, not money, investment advice or religious merchandise.

anand|anand31.line04.simpleEn: This spiritual treasure comes as a gift to those whom Hari blesses with grace.
anand|anand31.line04.simplePa: ਇਹ ਨਾਮ-ਧਨ ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਮਿਲਦਾ ਹੈ ਜਿਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਉੱਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਹੁੰਦੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand31.line04.interpretiveCaution: Trading and earnings refer to remembrance and ethical living, not money, investment advice or religious merchandise.

anand|anand31.line05.simpleEn: Nanak repeats: Hari is my capital, and my mind has become its trader.
anand|anand31.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੁੜ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ, ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨ ਉਸ ਦਾ ਵਣਜਾਰਾ ਬਣਿਆ ਹੈ।
anand|anand31.line05.interpretiveCaution: Trading and earnings refer to remembrance and ethical living, not money, investment advice or religious merchandise.

anand|anand32.line01.simpleEn: O tongue, while you are absorbed in other tastes, your deepest thirst remains unsatisfied.
anand|anand32.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਰਸਨਾ, ਹੋਰ ਸੁਆਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੁੱਝ ਕੇ ਵੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਅਸਲ ਪਿਆਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਟਦੀ।
anand|anand32.line01.interpretiveCaution: Hari ras is not an ingestible cure or diet. Do not diagnose cravings as sin or prescribe unsafe restraint.

anand|anand32.line02.simpleEn: No other taste finally removes this thirst until the joy of Hari is received.
anand|anand32.line02.simplePa: ਜਦ ਤਕ ਹਰਿ-ਰਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਮਿਲਦਾ, ਹੋਰ ਕਿਸੇ ਸੁਆਦ ਨਾਲ ਇਹ ਪਿਆਸ ਨਹੀਂ ਬੁੱਝਦੀ।
anand|anand32.line02.interpretiveCaution: Hari ras is not an ingestible cure or diet. Do not diagnose cravings as sin or prescribe unsafe restraint.

anand|anand32.line03.simpleEn: When one receives and drinks the sweetness of Hari, craving is pictured as falling away.
anand|anand32.line03.simplePa: ਜਦ ਮਨੁੱਖ ਹਰਿ-ਰਸ ਪੀਂਦਾ ਹੈ, ਤਦ ਤ੍ਰਿਸ਼ਨਾ ਦੀ ਪਿਆਸ ਮੁੜ ਨਹੀਂ ਸਤਾਉਂਦੀ—ਇਹ ਭਗਤੀ-ਤਸਵੀਰ ਹੈ।
anand|anand32.line03.interpretiveCaution: Hari ras is not an ingestible cure or diet. Do not diagnose cravings as sin or prescribe unsafe restraint.

anand|anand32.line04.simpleEn: This spiritual sweetness is received through grace and meeting the True Guru.
anand|anand32.line04.simplePa: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਦੀ ਮਿਲਾਪ ਤੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਾਲ ਇਹ ਹਰਿ-ਰਸ ਦੀ ਦਾਤ ਮਿਲਦੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand32.line04.interpretiveCaution: Hari ras is not an ingestible cure or diet. Do not diagnose cravings as sin or prescribe unsafe restraint.

anand|anand32.line05.simpleEn: Nanak says other competing tastes lose their hold when Hari enters the mind.
anand|anand32.line05.simplePa: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਖਦੇ ਹਨ: ਜਦ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਵੱਸਦਾ ਹੈ, ਹੋਰ ਰਸਾਂ ਦਾ ਮੋਹ ਘੱਟ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ।
anand|anand32.line05.interpretiveCaution: Hari ras is not an ingestible cure or diet. Do not diagnose cravings as sin or prescribe unsafe restraint.

anand|anand33.line01.simpleEn: O my body, Hari placed a light within you, and through it you came into the world.
anand|anand33.line01.simplePa: ਹੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਰੀਰ, ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਨੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਅੰਦਰ ਜੋਤ ਰੱਖੀ, ਇਸੇ ਨਾਲ ਤੂੰ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਇਆ।
anand|anand33.line01.interpretiveCaution: A spiritual source-of-life image does not provide an empirical account of embryology, biology or physiology.

anand|anand33.line02.simpleEn: That Divine light within the body is named again as the foundation of life.
anand|anand33.line02.simplePa: ਸਰੀਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਰੱਖੀ ਹਰਿ ਦੀ ਜੋਤ ਜੀਵਨ ਦਾ ਮੂਲ ਦੱਸ ਕੇ ਮੁੜ ਯਾਦ ਕੀਤੀ ਹੈ।
anand|anand33.line02.interpretiveCaution: A spiritual source-of-life image does not provide an empirical account of embryology, biology or physiology.
